ERP investment can lead to positive results in business performance only if the organization has a clear understanding of the ERP's objectives and the ERP is aligned with the organization's integration modes.
ERP investment positively affects business performance when the ERP system and integration modes are well aligned.
ERP systems can be used to improve operational efficiency, but only when they are aligned with the organizational integration modes used by a firm.

the alignment between ERP and organizational integration modes and its influence on business performance, and it is expected to contribute to the ERP research stream by suggesting a new perspective on ERP alignment and performance, as well as by providing a new approach to ERP implementation.
